input.body:
**PR #2 was merged into `main` without independent approval (CM-01 check D2).** 2 commits are affected.

**What I did**
- Branch guardrail: P1–P6 all **pass** right now (PR required, 1 approval, stale approvals dismissed, `test` required, no bypass actors, force-push/deletion blocked). I made no ruleset changes, so I didn't run verify_repo.
- PRs (D1) and tests (D3) **passed** for this period. Only approval (D2) failed.
- Retro-review issues already existed, so I didn't open duplicates:
  - `599d9a1` (merge of PR #2): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/5
  - `46d465d` (docs: add test instructions to README): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/6

**What you need to do**
- Get someone other than the author to review and sign off on issues #5 and #6. Those issues are the audit record.
- The guardrail passes now, but this PR still got merged without independent approval. Please check whether the ruleset was weaker at merge time (2026-10-07 19:54Z) or whether the author approved their own PR.

This repo is already classified as production, so no classification reply is needed.
